estimand: within-subject concurrent association of EGG band-power summaries and fNIRS ROI HbO/HbR summaries in protocol-relative 5-minute blocks
vas_alignment: observed numeric VAS mean per 5-minute block; minimum 3 numeric minutes; no imputation or cross-gap bridging
model: subject fixed effects plus categorical block; subject bootstrap
surrogate: within-subject permutation of EGG block labels, 20 replicates; descriptive null only
limitations: spectral summaries are not continuous synchronized waveforms
